title: 第19章 青云南域，谢家
novel_title: 伪装隐世仙族后，大佬疯狂跪舔我
content_zh:
如此阔绰的手笔，绝对不是他们小小青云洲域能有的。

    渡星槎上，微生璃月站在船头，眺望整个太虚宗。

    交错的山岭间，白色瀑布流水横亘其中，林叶茂密，偶尔还能听到仙鹤长鸣，确实是个不错的地方。

    此时太虚宗训练广场上，弟子们望着天上那艘巨大的仙舟，内心充满震撼。

    那位微生大小姐，到底是哪里来的怪物啊，能拿出如此不凡的宝物。

    要不是仙舟舰身上刻有“微生”二字，他们都怕是有大佬要来攻打太虚宗。

    叶不凡目光痴痴地望向天空，随即跟介子空间里的丹老交流：“丹老，你是从上界下来的大佬，可曾听过微生这个姓氏？”

    这些天待在太虚宗，他大致也了解了一点微生璃月的情况。

    性子骄纵，蛮横无理，出手却很阔绰，无论吃穿用度，样样都是最好。

    身边貌似还有合体期大佬相护，是个不折不扣的修N代。

    面对这种存在，在自己尚未成长起来之前，叶不凡现在不太敢去招惹。

    “未曾听过，但这些天跟着你，我大致也看出来一点，这小姑娘的身份怕是不简单，或许是从连我都没有资格触及的世界中过来也不一定。以后若是再遇上她，我们还是避避锋芒吧！”丹老沉思道。

    能随手拿出天阶高品法宝，就是在四十九大陆上，那也是顶级修炼世家才能拥有的实力。

    可在他知道的那些顶级世家里，并没有哪个家族是微生这个姓。

    再加上她身边那几个连他都看不出实力的侍从，这位微生小姐的家世怕是会比他想象的更加可怕。

    听到丹老对微生璃月的评价，叶不凡沉默道：“我知道了丹老，在没彻底成长起来之前，我会尽量避开她的。”

    太虚宗主殿，慕鹤云望向那连舟身都充满壕气的仙舟，心里有点乱：师兄啊师兄，你到底知不知道自己收了一个怎样的弟子。

    先是之前的月神殿，现在又是连他们宗门都没有的天阶高品法宝，要是一个伺候不好，他怕师兄这个小弟子会成为灭了他们宗门的小祖宗。
content_en:
Such a generous gesture is definitely not something that their small Qingyun Continent can have.

On the Xingcha, Weisheng Liyue stood on the bow, looking at the entire Taixu Sect.

Among the staggered mountains, white waterfalls and flowing water run across it, the forest leaves are dense, and you can occasionally hear the roar of cranes. It is indeed a good place.

At this time, in the Taixu Sect training square, the disciples looked at the huge fairy boat in the sky, and their hearts were filled with shock.

Where did that Miss Weisheng come from, who could produce such an extraordinary treasure?

If it weren't for the word "微生" engraved on the body of the Xianzhou ship, they would have been afraid that a big boss would come to attack Taixu Sect.

Ye Bufan looked at the sky dreamily, and then communicated with Elder Dan in the meson space: "Elder Dan, you are a big boss who came down from the upper world. Have you ever heard of the surname Wei Sheng?"

Staying in Taixu Sect these days, he also got a rough idea of Wei Sheng Liyue's situation.

He is arrogant, arrogant and unreasonable, but he is very generous in his dealings. Regardless of the cost of food and clothing, everything is the best.

It seems that he is protected by a big boss in the integration stage, and he is an out-and-out N-generation cultivator.

Faced with this kind of existence, Ye Bufan now doesn't dare to provoke it before he has grown up.

"I have never heard of it, but following you these days, I can roughly tell that this little girl's identity is not simple, and maybe she came from a world that even I am not qualified to touch. If we meet her again in the future, we should avoid the edge!" Elder Dan thought deeply.

Being able to easily take out heaven-level high-grade magic weapons, even on the Forty-Nine Continent, is a strength that can only be possessed by top cultivating families.

But among the top families he knew, there was no family with the surname Wei Sheng.

Coupled with the few attendants around her who even he could not see the strength of, Miss Wei Sheng's family background might be more terrifying than he imagined.

Hearing Mr. Dan's evaluation of Wei Sheng Liyue, Ye Bufan said silently: "I know Mr. Dan, and I will try my best to avoid her until I fully grow up."

In the main hall of Taixu Sect, Mu Heyun looked at the immortal boat that was filled with trench air, and felt a little confused: Senior brother, senior brother, do you know what kind of disciple you have accepted?

First there was the Moon God Temple before, and now there was a heaven-level high-grade magic weapon that even their sect did not have. If one of them did not serve him well, he was afraid that his junior disciple, his senior brother, would become the little ancestor who destroyed their sect.
